attributes.description: Daily storage, transfer, and estimated cost from Backblaze B2 usage reports.

query.esql: FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | INLINE STATS latest_day = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE @timestamp == latest_day | STATS `Stored (latest day)` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | INLINE STATS latest_day = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE @timestamp == latest_day | STATS `Stored (latest day)` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS gb_days = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 24.0 / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp) | EVAL `Est. storage cost / month` = GREATEST(gb_days / days - 10.0, 0.0) * 6.95 / 1000.0 | KEEP `Est. storage cost / month`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS gb_days = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 24.0 / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp) | EVAL `Est. storage cost / month` = GREATEST(gb_days / days - 10.0, 0.0) * 6.95 / 1000.0 | KEEP `Est. storage cost / month`
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Uploaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Uploaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Deleted` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.deleted_gb)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Deleted` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.deleted_gb)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Downloaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Downloaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS gb_days = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 24.0 / 1000000000.0, downloaded = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb) | EVAL `Free egress used` = downloaded / (gb_days * 3.0 / 30.0) | KEEP `Free egress used`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS gb_days = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 24.0 / 1000000000.0, downloaded = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb) | EVAL `Free egress used` = downloaded / (gb_days * 3.0 / 30.0) | KEEP `Free egress used`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | STATS stored_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb) BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp), Bucket = entity.name | SORT day

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | STATS stored_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb) BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp), Bucket = entity.name | SORT day
